reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000513 (the melody read from 000513a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Thomas Hastings's dates (1784–1872) are from our page for the tune TOPLADY (content/hymns/tunes/toplady.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1831. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000513a.nwc). The tune ends on F#, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
